Brand
Foundations

Who we are

About Urban Money

Urban Money acts as a loan aggregator, advisor, and distribution platform, connecting borrowers with banks and NBFCs while assisting throughout the entire borrowing journey.

It offers home loans, personal loans, business loans, loan against property (LAP), vehicle loans, education loans, commercial vehicle loans, insurance, credit cards, and credit score services.

Core offerings
Home Loans
Personal Loans
Business Loans & LAP
Vehicle Loans
Credit Cards & Insurance
Credit Score Services

Logo Overview

Stability, trust, forward-thinking finance

The Urban Money logo is a core element of our brand identity. It symbolizes stability, trust, and forward-thinking finance, while maintaining a clean and modern design.

The logo reflects our promise of clarity, accessibility, and growth in financial solutions. To maintain consistency, the following guidelines ensure its proper usage across all mediums and applications.

Logo Overview

Monogram & Icon

The Urban Money monogram and icon are designed to serve as strong, recognizable brand identifiers across both digital and physical platforms. They represent the brand in its simplest, most flexible form, ensuring visibility and recognition even in compact spaces.

Chapter 04

Video
Production

Production Standards

Urban Money Video Shoot Guidelines

01
Camera
  • 3–5 sec buffer before/after
  • Never stop mid-speech
02
Lighting
  • Keep lighting consistent
  • Re-record if it changes
03
Audio
  • Quiet location
  • Avoid echo/noise/AC
04
Camera Position
  • Eye level, stable frame
  • Proper headroom
05
Speaker
  • Eye contact, clear & confident
  • Natural pauses
06
Background
  • Clean office
  • Avoid clutter/windows
Production Standards

Recording Workflow & Final Checklist

Script & Recording
  • Read script 2–3 times
  • Follow A-Roll & VO
  • Don't split sentences randomly
Thumbnail
  • Face camera
  • Eye contact
  • Clean background
  • High-res photos
Preferred Shots
  • Talking
  • Desk
  • Walking
  • Laptop
  • Team discussion
Final checklist
  • Stable camera
  • 3–5 sec buffer
  • Consistent lighting
  • Clean audio
  • Professional background
  • Capture B-roll & thumbnails
  • Review footage before leaving
Brand Representation

On-Camera Look

The talent should present a neat, polished and professional appearance on camera, while remaining approachable and relatable. Urban Money branded T-shirts should be clearly visible at all times. The branded T-shirt/polo should be the primary on-camera outfit, paired with clean, neutral bottoms — smart and premium, minimal accessories, branding always clearly visible.
